title: Keep a complete instrument bound distinct from covariance matching
statement: For the actual augmented-feature receiver and specified independent detector vacua, d²=max_(z in {+1,-1}^n)z^T N z gives complete half-trace error <=sqrt(1-exp(-d²)). The comparison retains source, arbitrary reference and EVERY actual raw outcome; the initially correlated source/field baseline record need not be independent.

requires: Supplied finite features, chronological arrivals, no-return retired fields and actual accessible retained registers
Independent detector supply, calibrated Gaussian controls/reporting; complete-record theorem uses its specified controlled-Weyl dilation and actual feedback
provides: A state-uniform complete corrected-instrument comparison for the same actual receiver
assumptions: Not an arbitrary raw refinement of the same reported Gaussian marginal
Physical optical errors on arbitrarily energetic fields need another contract
costs: Retained modes at every cut, fresh modes/live width, energy, precision, gains, complete records, controls, storage/reset and full acquisition costs separately paid
contract.units: Dimensionless complete half-trace error; d² in the stipulated Weyl/vacuum normalization.
contract.obstruction: Matching a Gaussian covariance does not supply a complete record-retaining channel guarantee.

body: The acquired synthesis audit records actual proof and six independent-review pins; the separate six review texts/receipts and some correction/loss originals were not exposed.
